extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Natural resources — natural resources are things from nature that we use to live. Main resources: water (drinking, farming, cooking, cleaning), soil (growing crops, plants, and trees), forests (wood, paper, medicine, fruits, oxygen, shelter for animals), sun (light, heat, solar energy), air (breathing, wind energy), minerals (from rocks). Natural resources are FREE from nature but LIMITED — we must conserve them. (2) Forests — forests give us: wood (furniture, houses), paper (from wood pulp), medicine (neem, tulsi), fruits (mango, apple), oxygen (trees clean air), shelter for animals and birds. Forests prevent soil erosion and floods. Cutting too many trees = deforestation = less oxygen, more floods, less rain. (3) Soil — soil is the top layer of earth where plants grow. Fertile soil has nutrients for crops. Without soil, we cannot grow food. Soil is made from broken rocks and dead leaves over thousands of years. (4) Water conservation — water is limited. Save water: turn off taps, fix leaks, use buckets not hoses, collect rainwater, recycle water. Don't pollute rivers with garbage and chemicals. (5) Local geography — your local region has specific natural features: nearby rivers, landforms (mountains, plains), climate, crops that grow, natural resources available. Understanding local geography helps us use resources wisely. Misconceptions: 'natural resources are unlimited' (many resources like water and forests are limited — we must conserve them), 'soil is just dirt' (soil is valuable — it has nutrients that grow our food), 'forests are only for wood' (forests give oxygen, medicine, fruits, prevent floods, and shelter animals), 'paper comes from factories' (paper is made from wood pulp — cutting trees for paper causes deforestation), 'water will never run out' (clean drinking water is limited — many places face water shortage). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ResourcesGame), NOT export default. Export interface ResourcesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
